messages.content:
To see contestants information from the `CONTESTANTS` table, use:

```sql
SELECT
  contestant_number,
  contestant_name
FROM CONTESTANTS
ORDER BY contestant_number;
```

If you meant “contestants info + how many votes each has”, use:

```sql
SELECT
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(v.vote_id) AS vote_count
FROM CONTESTANTS c
LEFT JOIN VOTES v
  ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
GROUP BY c.contestant_number, c.contestant_name
ORDER BY vote_count DESC, c.contestant_number;
```
focus on contestants who got at least two votes

```sql
SELECT
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(v.vote_id) AS vote_count
FROM CONTESTANTS c
JOIN VOTES v
  ON v.contestant_number = c.contestant_number
GROUP BY c.contestant_number, c.contestant_name
HAVING COUNT(v.vote_id) >= 2
ORDER BY vote_count DESC, c.contestant_number;
```
